_comment: High/critical npm audit findings deliberately accepted for now, checked by ../scripts/supply-chain-check.mjs. Each entry needs a reason tied to why it can't reach the shipped app, and a reviewBy date — the check hard-fails once that date passes, so this can't quietly become permanent. Full fix for all of these is `npm audit fix --force`, which bumps Expo SDK 54 -> 57 (breaking, needs a real upgrade pass + device testing).

accepted.reason: Metro bundler dependency (image dimension probing at build time). Runs only on the dev/CI machine during `expo start`/`eas build`, never inside the shipped app bundle.
Same as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr — Metro build-time only.
Pulled in by @expo/metro-config for processing web-target CSS at bundle time. Not reachable at runtime — the app never parses user-supplied CSS.
Pulled in by xcode (via @expo/config-plugins), used only during `expo prebuild`/`eas build` to edit the native Xcode project. Never runs on device.
